description.text: Introduction Electronics engineering is an engineering discipline which utilizes non-linear and active electrical components to design electronic circuits, devices and systems. The discipline typically also designs passive electrical components, usually based on printed circuit boards. MainCourse Duration 4 to 6 years Degree Awarded Qualified graduates are awarded graduation diploma and bachelor degree ofElectronic Engineering byUniversity of Electronic Science and Technology of China Fee Tuitionfeeis31200RMBperyear. Accommodationfeeisseparatelycharged. Future career Work in a very wide range of industries and the skills required are likewise variable. These range from basic circuit theory to the management skills required of project manager. The tools and equipment that an individual engineer may need are similarly variable.

duration.text: The Electronic Engineering at University of Electronic Science and Technology of China is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4333 USD/per year ￥ 31200 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.The Highest Diploma, which should be certified copies in Chinese or English; 2.Certificate of the language proficiency if there is(TOEFL or IELTS); 3.Official academic transcript(certified copies); 4.One photocopy of your valid national passport; 5.Others: kinds of certificates, including sports, arts and other relevant certificates are warmly welcome; 6. Physical Examination form. If you are already in China, the valid visa page is required. ★ All the application materials will not be returned. ★ The application is invalid if the application materials are incomplete.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be at the age between 18-35 years old 2.Applicants must be non-Chinese in good health. 2.Have attained a senior high school diploma. And TOEFL 80 orIELTS5.5 is required.
